fusions.name: Churned Turf
fusions.desc: Kicks up the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Clod Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a clod that deals 5 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Dig In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh Footing
fusions.desc: When you strike, your next 2 spells deal 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
